posts.name: Julia
posts.cooked:
Not that this thread is any of my business *sigh'...

Just in case that you guys have to find a new venue and nobody has a better idea, there is a pub in Southwark called The Lord Nelson (okay, so that isn''t really close to Victoria, unless you are looking at it from a global level, but still...).

I can vouch for the fact that they are very tolerant towards boardgamers, provided that they buy drinks. I have my birthday party there every year (where we do nothing but boardgame there for over 9 hours) and they are really cool about it. You'd need to mail them in advance, and tell them: "Look, we are 7 people from a boardgaming group and we are looking for a place to play boardgames and drink between x and y o'clock. Can you reserve a table or two for us in the back?" and they'll be cool with it, unless they're totally booked out. The drinks are apparently not bad, and they also do food until 5 o'clock which apparently is not bad either (although I've never tried it). 

It's a fun little bar, nice atmosphere, ususally not to loud and it's geek-proof.

The wallpaper sucks, though.
